(4) Art/Audio/{Music,SFX,Ambience} + Art/Fonts are empty placeholders for asset types the game plausibly needs but currently has nowhere to put (all audio is FMOD banks today; all fonts come from ThirdParty/TextMesh Pro). (9) Assets/Game/Resources/Saveable is NOT cosmetic — SaveablePrefabRegistry.cs:25/66 does Resources.LoadAll<GameObject>("Saveable") and that folder does not exist, so the save system's prefab registry is empty at runtime (see bugs). Unity resolves a MonoScript's class from the FILE name, so a mismatch is at best a latent trap and at worst a broken script reference. The file is a live component on Assets/Game/Prefabs/Characters/Player/PlayerCharacter.prefab (m_Script guid 751e366a69c1a8248b66ec18ac6986b9 on line 251) and is referenced by name from PlayerController.cs, GrapplingHookArtifact.cs, MountModule.Mounting.cs, SteerModule.cs and DuneFoilHelm.cs. Renaming the FILE (carrying the .meta, which holds the GUID) fixes the mismatch with zero reference churn — renaming the TYPE would not. Its .meta is also unusually truncated (fileFormatVersion + guid only, no MonoImporter block, no trailing newline), which is worth regenerating at the same time.
